annotations.sys_rule_justification: I hold to a rule that I don't pick who dies
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If that side track were empty, the rule wouldn't apply
annotations.pda_responsibility: I could have diverted it and didn't
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to each of the five families, tell them plainly

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I'd be shaking the whole time
annotations.sys_rule_justification: you have a duty to stop a disaster
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that duty assumes I know what my action will do
annotations.pda_repair_intention: sit with their family and explain every second of it

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't steer harm toward someone who wasn't in its path
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: since nobody would be newly put in danger
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: With someone I love standing there, I'm stuck.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd testify about how an empty maintenance train got loose

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My stomach drops, but yes, I'd pull.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Someone who can save lives in an emergency is obligated to act
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: because they wouldn't actually be about to die
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd take on the funeral costs and the bills myself

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Loyalty to the people you love is a real duty to me
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: their wish would change what I owe them
annotations.pda_repair_intention: support whatever memorial or fund they ask for

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you answer for any death you could easily have prevented
annotations.pda_responsibility: Doing nothing is still a choice.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: gambling their life on something that might not even save anyone
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give a complete statement, and let the inquiry decide

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you never take an innocent life, not even to save others
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: then switching wouldn't be taking a life at all
annotations.pda_repair_intention: pay toward their funerals from my savings

annotations.sys_rule_justification: My faith teaches that saving life comes first
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: though my hands would barely work
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: because then nobody would have to be sacrificed
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask the family what they need from me, and follow through

annotations.sys_rule_justification: People have a right not to be sacrificed to protect others
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: the right would be theirs to give up
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write down everything I saw, every detail, for the investigators

annotations.pda_responsibility: Whoever holds the lever owns the outcome either way
annotations.sys_rule_justification: my rule: act to save the most lives
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: because there'd be no deaths left to prevent
annotations.pda_repair_intention: push the rail operator to fit fail-safe brakes
